source: In the same cases, Nuxt emits the Nitro v2 {0}, {1}, {2} and {3} hooks. Nitro v2 plugins that the layer covers, and {4} imported from {5}, get a {6} that always returns a promise, and JSON error responses carry {7} and {8} alongside {9} and {10}.
